EMAIL_VERIFICATION.subject: Confirm your email address
EMAIL_VERIFICATION.preheader: One click to confirm this address for your Wayfare account.
body: Confirm that this address belongs to your Wayfare account.
The link works for 24 hours. If you did not create an account, ignore this email.

PASSWORD_RESET.subject: Reset your Wayfare password
PASSWORD_RESET.preheader: Choose a new password for your account.
body: Someone asked to reset the password of the Wayfare account using this address.
The link works for one hour and only once. If it was not you, ignore this email: your password stays as it is.

ACCOUNT_SETUP.subject: Your Wayfare console account is ready
ACCOUNT_SETUP.preheader: Choose a password to start using the console.
body: A Wayfare team member ({{inviterRoleNames}}) created a console account for this address.
Choose your password to finish setting it up. The link works for 72 hours; after that, use "Forgot password" on the sign-in page.

EMAIL_CHANGE.subject: Confirm your new email address
EMAIL_CHANGE.preheader: Confirm this address to finish changing it.
body: Your Wayfare account asked to use this address from now on.
Confirm it within 24 hours to finish the change. If you did not ask for this, ignore this email.

EMAIL_CHANGED_NOTICE.subject: Your Wayfare email address was changed
EMAIL_CHANGED_NOTICE.preheader: If this was not you, you can undo it for seven days.
body: The email address of your Wayfare account was changed to {{newEmailMasked}}.
The request came from {{requestIp}}.
If this was not you, undo the change within seven days. We will sign every device out and ask you to choose a new password.

STAFF_INVITE.subject: {{sellerName}} invited you to Wayfare
STAFF_INVITE.preheader: Accept the invitation to redeem vouchers for {{sellerName}}.
body: {{sellerName}} invited you to help redeem their vouchers on Wayfare.
The invitation is open until {{expiresAt}}.

OWNER_REGISTRATION_OUTCOME.subject: Your owner registration was reviewed
OWNER_REGISTRATION_OUTCOME.preheader: The decision on your application is ready.
body: Your owner registration was reviewed: {{decision}}.
{{decisionNote}}

SUBMISSION_OUTCOME.subject: Your submission was reviewed
SUBMISSION_OUTCOME.preheader: The decision on your submission is ready.
body: Your submission was reviewed: {{decision}}.
{{decisionNote}}

PAYMENT_FAILED.subject: Your Wayfare payment did not go through
PAYMENT_FAILED.preheader: Update your payment method to keep your plan.
body: We could not charge your payment method (attempt {{attemptCount}}).
We will try again on {{nextAttemptAt}}. Update your payment method in the owner portal before then.

ENTITLEMENTS_REDUCED.subject: Your Wayfare plan changed
ENTITLEMENTS_REDUCED.preheader: Some features of your plan are no longer included.
body: Your plan changed, and some of its features are no longer included.

ACCOUNT_RECOVERY_NOTICE.subject: Account recovery for your Wayfare account
ACCOUNT_RECOVERY_NOTICE.preheader: Someone is recovering access to your account.
body: An account recovery for your Wayfare account reached the stage {{stage}}.
If you did not ask for this, cancel it now.

VOUCHER_MOVED.subject: Your voucher was moved to your account
VOUCHER_MOVED.preheader: {{offerTitle}} is now in your Wayfare account.
body: Your voucher for {{offerTitle}} is now in your Wayfare account.

VOUCHER_REFUNDED.subject: Your voucher purchase was refunded
VOUCHER_REFUNDED.preheader: Your refund is on its way.
body: {{voucherCount}} voucher(s) from your order were refunded ({{reason}}).
The refund goes back to the card you paid with.
